ordinary.unit: independent host process invocation; block gate uses the median of four invocation medians and mean of four invocation means; pooled 21-sample summaries are descriptive
ordinary.primary_targets: all nine primary target cases must show median improvement in both blocks

hot_R_control.scope: Separate compiler-disabled SizeOptimized/backtracking fresh-Store cohort. P/R owners stay loaded across samples; source production and loading excluded. This is not the ordinary Fast cohort.

reference.scope: Descriptive direct reference; primary unit independent process, median of two process medians and mean of two process means. Existing unequal setup boundaries preserved.
reference.boundary: V8 context creation is outside its execution clock. Scriptw Realm/bootstrap/completion remains inside. Scriptc Store/instantiation is outside; _start and output extraction are inside. Descriptive established boundaries, not equal end-to-end Realm costs. Endpoint RSS is not peak or live JS memory.

verification.test_only_correction: One new encoded test inspected ObjectRead instead of OrdinaryPropertyAppend. Preserve original 578 passes/1 failure and binary, exact one-line excluded-test correction, corrected 1-test pass and unchanged production proof. Do not claim a full rerun.
verification.product_semantics: Frozen NativeHost CLI boolean(true), Portable execution and actual retained-R hits; no-interpreter product graph passed.

runtime_fragment.scope: Exact named function fragment printed from the frozen Portable R; function header and body retained; external type/global names require its original module. Other R bodies/data omitted.
